summary: High-precision sniper tier of the no-GMC line: trial_0049@epoch20 with the discriminative candidate gate frozen at area>=1, sum_mode=abs, sum_value=14.5, gate_stage=post, tag_allow=[0,1,2], th_base=0.30. sum_value=14.5 is the true peak found by the 0.5-step fine sweep (fine_abs_finer_exclude-primary); the earlier 14.0 was an artifact of the even-grid coarse sweep. Ships DISABLED, like every other candidate-gate parameter file in this repository.

tier.name: high_precision_sniper
tier.note: The main install stays cs_t0043 (Model Soup). This package is the advanced tier, not the primary install. trial_0049 is a single-seed single-model bottom (epoch20, a sharp local minimum); its robustness on unseen extreme cold/hot operating points is slightly below the Model Soup products.

previous_tier.reason: The even-grid coarse sweep (fine_abs_exclude-primary, floor 6..28 step 2) placed the peak on the grid point 14. The 0.5-step fine sweep (fine_abs_finer_exclude-primary) resolved the true peak at 14.5.

provenance.note: Every number below is copied digit for digit from an existing artifact. Nothing in this package redefines a gate red line: the T1/T2/T3 thresholds and the hard-gate rule live upstream in the three-track gate chain and are only quoted here as observed values.

t1.gate_independence: T1 is not affected by the gate: the K2/K3 sweep measured only the T2 and T3 tracks, so the T1 value is carried over unchanged from the gate report.

t2.fields: rows[arm=t49, sum_mode=abs, sum_value=14.5, area_min=1, gate_stage=post, th_base=0.3] -> t2_f1 / t2_tp / t2_fp / t2_fn
t2.discrepancy_note: The 'f1' field holds the 9-decimal display value 0.998979; the artifact field is 0.9989791016094163. The difference is -1.016e-07. Both clear the upstream hard gate (F1 >= 0.985, FP <= 112).

t3.fields: rows[arm=t49, sum_mode=abs, sum_value=14.5, area_min=1, gate_stage=post, th_base=0.3] -> t3_f1 / t3_tp / t3_fp / t3_fn
t3.discrepancy_note: The 'f1' field holds the 9-decimal display value 0.911096427; the artifact field is 0.9110964265744929.

rc2.fields: section 0 reference table, row 'RC2 = trial_0080 ep3'
rc2.discrepancy_note: RC2 is a GMC-feature arm; it is a benchmark only and carries a different feature semantics. Its T2 F1 0.998949170 is RC2's own value and must not be mixed with trial_0049's T2.

frozen_delivery_params.note: th_base = 0.30 and dedup_radius = 768.0 are inherited from the frozen delivery configuration and are NOT changed by this package.

coarse_sweep.verdict: placed the peak on the grid point 14.0 -- a grid artifact, not the true peak

fine_sweep.scope: arm=t49, sum_mode=abs, area_min=1, gate_stage=post, th_base=0.3, sum_quantile_scope=exclude-primary
fine_sweep.verdict: true peak at sum_value=14.5 (post), T3 F1 0.9110964265744929

platform.note: 14.5..15.5 is a short plateau, not a knife edge

float_sensitivity.risk: sums is a floating-point accumulation of heatmap intensity over the connected component. A board implementation that accumulates in a different order or precision can produce slightly different sums values, so individual candidates sitting close to 14.5 can flip across the threshold.
float_sensitivity.server_reference: The server accumulates the component integral in float64 (numpy bincount with float64 weights) and stores it as float32 in the cache; the gate then compares the stored float32 value against the float32 threshold.
float_sensitivity.measured_sensitivity: Across the 0.5-step fine grid (post stage, 11..17) the largest adjacent-step change in T3 F1 is 0.000592 (13.5 -> 14.0); within the plateau neighbourhood 14.5 -> 16.0 the largest is 0.000222 (15.5 -> 16.0). A threshold perturbation of +/-0.25 around 14.5 moves T3 F1 by at most 0.000121 (interpolated: 14.25 -> 0.910975653, 14.75 -> 0.911018434), i.e. below 0.02 pp and far smaller than the gaps that separate the tiers.
float_sensitivity.plateau_safety: The delivered point sits on the 14.5..15.5 plateau (0.911096427 / 0.910940440 / 0.911005953, spread 0.000156 F1 = 0.0156 pp). A board implementation that lands anywhere on that plateau keeps the tier ordering and the delivery conclusion.
float_sensitivity.worst_case_regression: If the effective threshold drifted all the way to sums >= 16, T3 F1 would be 0.910784263830220 -- that is 0.0071 pp BELOW the superseded 14.0 tier (0.910854878854066), not above it, but still +1.3091 pp over RC2 (0.897693732) and still above 0.91.
float_sensitivity.contract_guidance: Accumulate sums in float32 with a fixed, deterministic summation order (aligned with the server's numpy.float32 storage), and implement the comparison as 'sums >= 14.5f' with a configurable +/-0.1 tolerance so that a near-threshold candidate flip cannot silently change the tier.

usage_notes.enabled_default: false -- the gate must be switched on explicitly by a downstream pipeline, exactly like manu/evaluation/system_sota_longquan_candgate_params.json.
usage_notes.difference_to_general_delivery_default: The general delivery default tier is sum_value = 16.0 (the largest floor that keeps the T2 hard gate comfortable on BOTH arms). This package freezes 14.5 because 14.5 is the T3 optimum for trial_0049 specifically; 16.0 costs trial_0049 about 0.0312 pp of T3 F1 and is better for cs_t0008p2. The two tiers are arm-specific and must not be interchanged.
usage_notes.why_not_20: sums >= 20 breaks the T2 hard gate on trial_0049 (T2 F1 0.978459 < 0.985). The safe delivery band for this arm remains 14..16.
usage_notes.corpus_scope: Across every sweep artifact in /mnt/data/siping/runs/nogmc_t3/decision_sweep, the global maximum T3 F1 is this package's 0.9110964265744929. The quantile-gate family peaks lower, at 0.910940440465897, so it is now surpassed; but a quantile gate has no construction guarantee of out-of-sample behaviour, which the absolute energy floor does have. The 119 pure-weight gate_report.json products contain none above 0.91; their maximum is trial_0049 at 0.906392.
usage_notes.out_of_sample_basis: sum_mode=abs is an absolute constant floor, so it carries no dataset-distribution calibration and needs no per-tag quantile table. That is a construction guarantee, not a measured property. sum_mode=tagq has no such guarantee: its threshold is a quantile of the energy population, and the in-sample optimum of that form failed out of sample.
